derivation_rule: A family must describe a repeated customer/authority/art-direction logic, not a color label or a single admired page.

families.name: Sensory Sanctuary / Atmospheric Rest
families.visual_thesis: Environment and material atmosphere carry desire before information becomes dominant.
families.boundary: Not equivalent to beige/green/natural styling. Requires a real sensory decision job.

families.name: Clinical Calm / Structured Reassurance
families.visual_thesis: Calm surfaces protect comprehension while evidence, boundaries and process carry trust.
families.boundary: Calmness without evidence or next action is insufficient.

families.name: Editorial High-Consideration / Aspirational Authority
families.visual_thesis: Aspirational visual authority is sustained into proof, performance and commitment decisions rather than abandoned after Hero.
customer_conditions: desire and rational reassurance both material
families.boundary: Large typography or luxury photography alone does not define the family.

families.name: Human Craft / Provenance-Led Intimacy
families.visual_thesis: Human-scale making, material detail and provenance create authority without corporate distance.
families.boundary: Do not romanticize locality or craft without actual process evidence.

families.name: Guided Choice / Diagnostic Clarity
families.visual_thesis: The page earns trust by reducing a complex or ambiguous choice into a legible sequence of smaller decisions.
families.boundary: Not a card-grid family. The family is the decision logic and authored choice sequence.

families.name: Proof-Led Process Authority
families.visual_thesis: Process, mechanism and operational evidence become the visual and persuasive center.
customer_conditions: B2B/technical logic can transfer to wellness proof
families.boundary: Feature inventory without task framing is not this family.

families.name: Local Human / Community Warmth
families.visual_thesis: Specific local relationships and real human context reduce distance without generic friendliness claims.
families.boundary: Locality must be concrete; generic '地域密着' mood is insufficient.

families.name: Category Education / Open Discovery
families.visual_thesis: When the category itself is unfamiliar, the page prioritizes understanding and self-placement before conversion.
families.boundary: Abstract brand language must be followed by concrete process/use/outcome evidence.

beauty_wellness_note: These are evidence-derived art-direction families proposed for Beauty/Wellness adaptation using same-industry and adjacent high-quality service evidence. They are not eight fixed templates and are not production-eligible until multi-company validation.
